author: N6rL
content: Blocked by L6 and L7 (need actual module imports to check). The required dependency direction from ROADMAP.md M0 done-condition: ingestion → understanding → library (core) ← synthesis ← interaction. 'Core' (alcanzai-core) is imported by understanding, synthesis, and interaction but imports nothing from the Python frontier. Scope: add a CI/lint check that verifies no module imports across layer boundaries in the wrong direction — e.g. alcanzai-core must not import alcanzai-ingestion; alcanzai-ingestion must not import alcanzai-synthesis. Tool options: import-linter (Python), a custom script, or cargo's module visibility for the Rust side. AC: check passes on the M0 skeleton; deliberately adding a cross-layer import in the wrong direction causes the check to fail (run this manually and confirm before closing); check is wired into CI. The check running clean is one of the three M0 done-conditions.
